# Offer evidence brief

OfferBrief.v1

## Source S1

    Synthetic producer interview

Recorded 2026-11-19. Supplied by the author.

    I copy the same approved shoot note into three different handover documents.

## Buyer hypothesis

    Small video production teams

## Offer hypothesis

    One editable crew handover assembled from a producer-approved shoot note.

S1 informed this hypothesis. Demand still needs a market test.

## Economics per sale

- Assumed price: EUR 49.00
- Assumed variable cost: EUR 12.50
- Contribution before fixed costs: EUR 36.50
- Contribution margin: 74.5%

## Planned experiment

    Within seven days, show one sample handover to three independent producers and invite each to submit a redacted second note at the stated price.

## Acceptance criterion

    Proceed only if a producer asks for a paid second handover at EUR 49. Record the response before contacting more producers.

## Owner approval

A person approves outreach, publication, pricing commitments and spending.
